title: Local data provenance catalog
scope: Repository-local inventory only. It deliberately makes no network request and does not assert rights not evidenced by a tracked file.

allowed_local_inputs: repository-licensed software and clearly identified local seed metadata
clearly synthetic test or demo personas
content with a source-specific rights record that has been independently approved

sources.evidence: LICENSE names the software and associated documentation; it does not identify provenance for every embedded learning-data artifact.
LOCAL_BOOTSTRAP.md selects this built-in catalog as the minimal local seed and seed_shop_items.py upserts it by name.
The script creates demo_...@lexilingo.dev accounts and deletes only that namespace before recreating random demo activity.
Fixtures and their tests exercise declared upstream metadata; their presence is not an approval to ship the represented source data.
DATA_AUDIT.md identifies generated/curated artifacts and recommends recording source ID, license, split, and transformation on every imported record.
The script declares BBC, NASA, NYT, and Guardian RSS URLs. The independent-development plan blocks external acquisition until a written rights decision.

artifacts.evidence: MIT license is retained for software and documentation; do not infer learning-content rights from it.
The documented local minimal seed is an upsert by item name. No completed local seed-run log was found in the repository.
Use only in an isolated local database: both scripts deliberately delete their own demo/test email namespaces before reseeding. They are not production-user data.
DATA_AUDIT.md calls the 68 records role-play blueprints, not complete graded readers. seed_stories.py upserts by story_id, but the data lacks a source-specific rights manifest.

DATA_AUDIT.md records duplicate, schema, coverage, and cross-file-reference risks. The existing crawl report also names external URLs, so this catalog does not treat the graph as cleared for distribution.
A large vocabulary JSON is tracked but the inventory found no source-specific license or attribution file beside it.
The file contains editorial learning text but no author, source URL, license, or retrieval record.
The contract fixture uses placeholder hashes and synthetic word00-style records while exercising complete provenance fields.
OEWN, Tatoeba, Common Voice, LibriSpeech, CMUdict, CEFR-J, and Wikidata names appear as narrow test fixtures; acquire and approve real snapshots separately before runtime use.
This entrypoint fetches external RSS sources. It must remain unused under the current local-only/no-external-collection directive.

seed_entrypoints.idempotency: schema bootstrap only; fresh or Alembic-versioned databases upgrade, populated unversioned databases are refused

deletes test-email namespaces then recreates deterministic-seeded analytics data
